import requests

def get_uniprot_info(gene_name):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true&fields=accession,id,gene_names,protein_name,sequence,mass"
    resp = requests.get(url)
    data = resp.json()
    return data

for gene in ["PSIP1", "FPGT"]:
    info = get_uniprot_info(gene)
    print(f"Gene: {gene}")
    for entry in info.get("results", []):
        acc = entry.get("primaryAccession")
        entry_name = entry.get("uniProtkbId")
        seq_info = entry.get("sequence", {})
        length = seq_info.get("length")
        mass = seq_info.get("molWeight")
        print(f"  Accession: {acc}, Name: {entry_name}, Length: {length} aa, Mass: {mass} Da ({mass/1000.0:.2f} kDa)")

from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

handle = Entrez.efetch(db="protein", id="NP_015551.2,NP_003829.2", rettype="fasta", retmode="text")
records = handle.read().strip().split(">")[1:]
for r in records:
    lines = r.split("\n")
    header = lines[0]
    seq = "".join(lines[1:])
    analyzed = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
    mw = analyzed.molecular_weight()
    print(f"Header: {header}")
    print(f"Length: {len(seq)} aa, MW: {mw:.2f} Da, MW: {mw/1000:.2f} kDa")

GDP-L-fucose pyrophosphorylase. Purification, cDNA cloning, and properties of the
enzyme.

Pastuszak I(1), Ketchum C, Hermanson G, Sjoberg EJ, Drake RR, Elbein AD.

Author information:
(1)Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Arkansas for
Medical Sciences, Little Rock, Arkansas 72205, USA.

GDP-L-fucose pyrophosphorylase (fucose-1-phosphate guanylyltransferase; EC
2.7.7.52) catalyzes the formation of GDP-L-fucose from GTP and
beta-L-fucose-1-phosphate. The enzyme was purified about 25,000-fold to
homogeneity from pig kidney. Its molecular mass was estimated to be 65 kDa by SDS
polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis and 68 kDa by Sephacryl S-200 gel filtration.
Peptide sequence data obtained from the pig kidney enzyme was used to design
oligonucleotides to screen an expressed sequence tag data base. A human liver
clone was identified and sequenced. It encoded a protein of 594 amino acids with a
predicted molecular mass of 66.6 kDa. Expression of the full-length cDNA in
COS-1 cells and in Escherichia coli gave good levels of GDP-L-fucose
pyrophosphorylase activity. The expressed human kidney enzyme migrated on
SDS-PAGE like the purified pig kidney enzyme at about 65 kDa. Antibodies
prepared in rabbits against the human protein expressed in E. coli inhibited
enzyme activity of the pig kidney enzyme and gave a single band on Western blots
of the pig kidney enzyme. Northern blots of human and pig tissues revealed a
major mRNA of about 3.3 kilobases, with highest levels in liver and kidney.

DOI: 10.1074/jbc.273.41.26857
